eligibility: Same closing single heads-up river bet as parent. One distinct reached hand. Include no-op and protected cases in score. Full chips from the normal six-player engine on both terminal actions. Never expose target, actual opponent hand or field identity to playing policy.
train_reach: Hero plays the selected prior policy. Other seats use common 480 preflop and previous seat-assigned historic mixture on flop/turn; on river all nonhero seats play the named training strategy. No forcing bet sizes.
holdout_reach: All five nonhero seats play the named unseen river-training opponent on all streets including preflop. Evaluate original full-table reach under the prior active hero. Groups are the independent public model Fullhouse and the upstream behavioral SolverLike; no claim either is a verified professional opponent.

fit.start: Exact serving coefficients, intercept, normalization and logit offset of the selected river parent. One residual model with 10 slopes + intercept, initialized at zero.
fit.mixture: 50% total original 2304 train rows; 50% total new rows with equal new opponent x fixed seed weights. Prior holdout unavailable to fitting.
fit.loss: Mean weighted soft-label showdown cross entropy + .025*squared slope residual norm + .005*squared intercept residual.
fit.optimizer: L-BFGS, maximum 200 optimizer iterations. No mid-training performance stop, tuning, repeated candidate or new feature selection.

policy.parent: Begin from exact served river-call-learning distribution, keeping protected hands and all raise actions/probabilities, including seeded raises.
policy.eligible_change: If updated showdown share exceeds or falls short of pot odds by >=0.05 absolute, transfer 25% of the remaining opposite passive action probability toward that choice. Preserve parent elsewhere.

selection.unit: One fresh originally dealt hand contributes at most one decision; matched counterfactual chip settlement with both passive actions.
selection.score: delta at a reached decision = (candidate Pcall - previous learned parent Pcall)*(call chips-fold chips)/100. Equal 6 holdout cells, fixed-three-seed stratified SE.
selection.adopt: Single test after weight freeze. Equal-cell reached-decision mean minus 1.96 * stratified SE must exceed zero AND equal-cell observed all-deal contribution (100 * sum(decision gains)/attempted deals per cell) must be positive. No single-opponent veto. Otherwise retain incumbent, no automatic retry.
selection.report: Include opponent-specific and fixed-seed results, actual changes and betting-size exposure; distinguish incremental returns from absolute win rates. Scoring uses both complete holdout fields. If a range is exhausted report incompleteness without substituting cards.
